title: Patching lemma: integer multiplicity is a local property
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, k ∈ ℕ and X ∈ D_k(U). If every x ∈ U has an open neighbourhood V ⊆ U and an integer multiplicity Y ∈ D_k(U) such that X(ω) = Y(ω) for every test form ω with tsupport ω ⊆ V, then X is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn U k, (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ V : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ V ⊆ U ∧ ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U k, IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) ⊆ V → X ω = Y ω) → IsIntegerMultiplicity X
